description: Defines the Netlink class, a wrapper for manipulating IP addresses and routing tables via netlink sockets in the quic namespace. It includes methods for retrieving link info, addresses, route info, and modifying routes and rules, using netlink communication with the kernel.

classes.name: Netlink
classes.description: A wrapper class for netlink socket operations to manipulate IP addresses and routing rules, not thread-safe but thread-compatible.

methods.name: GetLinkInfo
methods.description: Retrieves link information for a specified network interface.

methods.name: GetAddresses
methods.description: Retrieves IP addresses associated with a network interface.

methods.name: ChangeLocalAddress
methods.description: Modifies local addresses on a network interface.

methods.name: GetRouteInfo
methods.description: Retrieves routing rules from the main routing table.

methods.name: ChangeRoute
methods.description: Adds, removes, or replaces routing rules.

methods.name: ChangeRule
methods.description: Adds, removes, or replaces routing policy rules.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Sends a netlink message to the kernel.

methods.name: Recv
methods.description: Receives a netlink message from the kernel.
